grammar.purpose: Concede one fact while keeping another judgment separate
grammar.explanation: Repeating X around 归 acknowledges that issue before giving a different point. In speech, the following clause often uses 但/还是. It does not mean X is unimportant.

examples.zh: 紧张归紧张，你还是唱完了。
examples.py: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi chàng wán le .
examples.en: Nervous or not, you still finished.

examples.zh: 贵归贵，这次我还是想买。
examples.py: guì guī guì , zhè cì wǒ hái shi xiǎng mǎi .
examples.en: It is expensive, but this time I still want to buy it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 紧张归紧张，所以紧张不存在。
commonMistakes.right: 紧张归紧张，你还是唱完了。
commonMistakes.why: The first clause acknowledges the feeling; it does not deny it.

grammar.purpose: State a continuing intention despite an extreme degree
grammar.explanation: 再 before an adjective or mental verb supplies the challenging degree; 也 introduces what still holds. The statement can be a personal intention rather than a guarantee of achievement.

examples.zh: 再紧张，我也想把它唱完。
examples.py: zài jǐn zhāng , wǒ yě xiǎng bǎ tā chàng wán .
examples.en: However nervous I am, I still want to finish it.

examples.zh: 这段再快，我也可以先练两句。
examples.py: zhè duàn zài kuài , wǒ yě kě yǐ xiān liàn liǎng jù .
examples.en: However fast this section is, I can start by practising two lines.

commonMistakes.wrong: 再紧张，我也想把它唱完，所以我已经唱完了。
commonMistakes.right: 再紧张，我也想把它唱完。
commonMistakes.why: An intention to finish does not establish that finishing has already happened.

grammar.pattern: 动词 / 形容词 + 得 + clause
grammar.purpose: Describe an effect on a person
grammar.explanation: After 得, a clause can name the effect of the manner or degree, including a different subject. Compare a degree adjective with a consequence rather than inserting 得 anywhere.

examples.zh: 音乐快得我都跟不上了。
examples.py: yīn yuè kuài de wǒ dōu gēn bù shàng le .
examples.en: The music is so fast I cannot keep up.

examples.py: wǒ jǐn zhāng de shǒu xīn dōu shī le .
examples.en: I am so nervous my palms are damp.

commonMistakes.wrong: 音乐得快我都跟不上了。
commonMistakes.right: 音乐快得我都跟不上了。
commonMistakes.why: Put 得 after the adjective 快 and before the consequence clause.

grammar.purpose: Attribute an assessment to a perspective
grammar.explanation: 在 plus a person and 看来 frames an opinion from that standpoint. It leaves room for others to notice different things; evidence still needs to be named.

examples.zh: 在我看来，后面接上了也是进步。
examples.py: zài wǒ kàn lái , hòu miàn jiē shàng le yě shì jìn bù .
examples.en: In my view, picking it up afterwards is progress too.

examples.zh: 在她看来，先休息再听比较好。
examples.py: zài tā kàn lái , xiān xiū xī zài tīng bǐ jiào hǎo .
examples.en: She thinks resting before listening is better.

commonMistakes.wrong: 在我看来，所以所有人都一定同意。
commonMistakes.right: 在我看来，后面接上了也是进步。
commonMistakes.why: A framed opinion does not prove agreement from everyone.

grammar.explanation: 还是 presents alternatives in a question. Let the actual answer settle which sequence will be followed rather than assuming the first option was chosen.

examples.zh: 现在听，还是吃完东西再听？
examples.py: xiàn zài tīng , hái shi chī wán dōng xi zài tīng ?

examples.zh: 先说问题，还是先听录音？
examples.py: xiān shuō wèn tí , hái shi xiān tīng lù yīn ?
examples.en: Discuss the problem first, or listen to the recording first?

commonMistakes.wrong: 现在听或者吃完再听？所以我们已经选了现在。
commonMistakes.right: 现在听，还是吃完东西再听？
commonMistakes.why: An alternatives question does not itself establish a choice; the scene’s reply does.

dialogue.title: 紧张归紧张，你唱完了
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你怎么一个人坐在这里？大家还在里面聊天。
lines.py: nǐ zěn me yī gè rén zuò zài zhè lǐ ? dà jiā hái zài lǐ miàn liáo tiān .
lines.en: Why are you sitting here alone? Everyone’s still chatting inside.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想先出来一会儿。刚才第二句唱错了，后面差点接不上。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān chū lái yī huì er . gāng cái dì èr jù chàng cuò le , hòu miàn chà diǎn jiē bù shàng .
lines.en: I wanted a moment outside. I got the second line wrong and nearly lost the next part.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我听见你停了一下，不过后来接上了。
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiàn nǐ tíng le yī xià , bù guò hòu lái jiē shàng le .
lines.en: I heard you pause, but you picked it up again.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你不用安慰我，我知道和练的时候不一样。
lines.py: nǐ bù yòng ān wèi wǒ , wǒ zhī dào hé liàn de shí hou bù yī yàng .
lines.en: You don’t need to reassure me. I know it wasn’t like rehearsal.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我没说没有错。我是说你没停在那里，后面唱完了。
lines.py: wǒ méi shuō méi yǒu cuò . wǒ shì shuō nǐ méi tíng zài nà lǐ , hòu miàn chàng wán le .
lines.en: I’m not saying there was no mistake. I’m saying you didn’t stop there; you finished the rest.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这点倒是。可我准备了那么久，还是有点失望。
lines.py: zhè diǎn dǎo shì . kě wǒ zhǔn bèi le nà me jiǔ , hái shi yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
lines.en: That’s true, but I prepared so long and I’m still a little disappointed.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 紧张归紧张，你还是站上去了。你第一次来，只在后面听呢。
lines.py: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi zhàn shàng qù le . nǐ dì yī cì lái , zhǐ zài hòu miàn tīng ne .
lines.en: Nervous or not, you still went on stage. The first time you came you only listened at the back.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别从我第一次来开始讲了。我就想知道第二句怎么改。
lines.py: bié cóng wǒ dì yī cì lái kāi shǐ jiǎng le . wǒ jiù xiǎng zhī dào dì èr jù zěn me gǎi .
lines.en: Don’t start from the first time I came. I just want to know how to fix the second line.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，现在听录音，还是吃完东西再听？
lines.py: hǎo , xiàn zài tīng lù yīn , hái shi chī wán dōng xi zài tīng ?
lines.en: Okay. Listen to the recording now, or after some food?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 吃完再听吧。我现在一听见自己的声音就想关掉。
lines.py: chī wán zài tīng ba . wǒ xiàn zài yī tīng jiàn zì jǐ de shēng yīn jiù xiǎng guān diào .
lines.en: After food. Right now hearing my own voice makes me want to switch it off.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。等会儿只听那两句，不用把整段一直重复。
lines.py: xíng . děng huì ér zhǐ tīng nà liǎng jù , bù yòng bǎ zhěng duàn yì zhí chóng fù .
lines.en: Sure. Later we’ll listen only to those two lines, not keep repeating the whole thing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你觉得是字没读准，还是跟音乐太急？
lines.py: nǐ jué de shì zì méi dú zhǔn , hái shi gēn yīn yuè tài jí ?
lines.en: Do you think the word was wrong, or I rushed with the music?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我得再听一次才敢说。刚才只是听见你漏了两个字。
lines.py: wǒ děi zài tīng yī cì cái gǎn shuō . gāng cái zhǐ shì tīng jiàn nǐ lòu le liǎng gè zì .
lines.en: I need another listen before saying. I only heard you miss two characters.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这样说我反而放心。你要是说全部都完美，我才不信。
lines.py: zhè yàng shuō wǒ fǎn ér fàng xīn . nǐ yào shì shuō quán bù dōu wán měi , wǒ cái bù xìn .
lines.en: That actually reassures me. If you said everything was perfect, I wouldn’t believe it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 放心，我没那么会夸人。
lines.py: fàng xīn , wǒ méi nà me huì kuā rén .
lines.en: Don’t worry; I’m not that good at lavish praise.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这个不用练。你先帮我拿点水吧。
lines.py: zhè gè bù yòng liàn . nǐ xiān bāng wǒ ná diǎn shuǐ ba .
lines.en: No need to practise that. Get me some water first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。要不要我跟大家说你等会儿回去？
lines.py: hǎo . yào bù yào wǒ gēn dà jiā shuō nǐ děng huì ér huí qù ?
lines.en: Okay. Shall I tell the others you’ll be back later?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 说一下吧，别让他们以为我直接走了。
lines.py: shuō yī xià ba , bié ràng tā men yǐ wéi wǒ zhí jiē zǒu le .
lines.en: Yes, so they don’t think I’ve left altogether.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: 紧张归紧张，你唱完了
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 去唱歌活动以前，我在家练了十几次。音乐放慢时，每一句都能接上，我就以为到了现场也会一样。那天轮到我，站到前面才发现，听见的声音和房间里不太一样，手里拿着话筒，也不知道该看哪里。
lines.py: qù chàng gē huó dòng yǐ qián , wǒ zài jiā liàn le shí jǐ cì . yīn yuè fàng màn shí , měi yī jù dōu néng jiē shàng , wǒ jiù yǐ wéi dào le xiàn chǎng yě huì yī yàng . nà tiān lún dào wǒ , zhàn dào qián miàn cái fā xiàn , tīng jiàn de shēng yīn hé fáng jiān lǐ bù tài yī yàng , shǒu lǐ ná zhe huà tǒng , yě bù zhī dào gāi kàn nǎ lǐ .
lines.en: Before the singing event I rehearsed more than ten times at home. I could keep up with every line when the music was slowed, so I expected the same at the event. Standing at the front, I found the sound different from my room and didn’t know where to look while holding the microphone.

lines.zh: 第二句里有两个字，我还没唱完，音乐已经往下走了。我停了一下，差点接不上下一句。幸好前面的朋友用手给我指了开始的位置，我又跟了上去，最后唱完了整段。坐下以后，我只记得那两秒，觉得前面准备的都没有用。
lines.py: dì èr jù lǐ yǒu liǎng gè zì , wǒ hái méi chàng wán , yīn yuè yǐ jīng wǎng xià zǒu le . wǒ tíng le yī xià , chà diǎn jiē bù shàng xià yī jù . xìng hǎo qián miàn de péng you yòng shǒu gěi wǒ zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì , wǒ yòu gēn le shàng qù , zuì hòu chàng wán le zhěng duàn . zuò xià yǐ hòu , wǒ zhǐ jì de nà liǎng miǎo , jué de qián miàn zhǔn bèi de dōu méi yǒu yòng .
lines.en: Two characters in the second line fell behind the music. I paused and nearly missed the next line. A friend pointed to where I should restart, and I picked it up and finished the section. Afterwards I remembered only those two seconds and felt all my preparation had been useless.

lines.zh: 我到门外坐了一会儿，朋友跟出来问怎么了。他说我后来接上了，我却以为他只是安慰。我们说了几句，我才听清楚：他并没有说我唱得完美，只说出了一个我自己没注意的事实。我确实没有在失误的地方结束。
lines.py: wǒ dào mén wài zuò le yī huì er , péng you gēn chū lái wèn zěn me le . tā shuō wǒ hòu lái jiē shàng le , wǒ què yǐ wéi tā zhǐ shì ān wèi . wǒ men shuō le jǐ jù , wǒ cái tīng qīng chǔ : tā bìng méi yǒu shuō wǒ chàng de wán měi , zhǐ shuō chū le yī gè wǒ zì jǐ méi zhù yì de shì shí . wǒ què shí méi yǒu zài shī wù de dì fāng jié shù .
lines.en: I sat outside briefly, and a friend came to ask what was wrong. When he said I’d picked it up again, I thought he was merely comforting me. After talking I understood: he hadn’t called it perfect, just named a fact I’d overlooked. I hadn’t ended at the mistake.

lines.zh: 我们先去吃东西。我不想刚坐下就反复听自己的录音，他也没有催我。吃完以后，我们找了个安静的地方，只听第二句和后面接上的一句。听的时候，我发现那两个字没跟上，但后面并不像自己记得的那么乱。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān qù chī dōng xi . wǒ bù xiǎng gāng zuò xià jiù fǎn fù tīng zì jǐ de lù yīn , tā yě méi yǒu cuī wǒ . chī wán yǐ hòu , wǒ men zhǎo le gè ān jìng de dì fāng , zhǐ tīng dì èr jù hé hòu miàn jiē shàng de yī jù . tīng de shí hou , wǒ fā xiàn nà liǎng gè zì méi gēn shàng , dàn hòu miàn bìng bù xiàng zì jǐ jì de de nà me luàn .
lines.en: We ate first. I didn’t want to keep hearing my recording immediately, and he didn’t rush me. Afterwards we found a quiet place and listened only to the second line and the next one. The two characters had fallen behind, but the following line wasn’t as chaotic as I remembered.

lines.zh: 朋友让我先按普通说话的方式读那两句，再试着跟音乐。我把快的地方分开练，没有每次从头开始。录音里哪里少了字，我们就停在哪里；不是所有地方都用同一个办法重做。这样练十分钟以后，我至少知道下一次要注意哪个位置。
lines.py: péng you ràng wǒ xiān àn pǔ tōng shuō huà de fāng shì dú nà liǎng jù , zài shì zhe gēn yīn yuè . wǒ bǎ kuài de dì fāng fēn kāi liàn , méi yǒu měi cì cóng tóu kāi shǐ . lù yīn lǐ nǎ lǐ shǎo le zì , wǒ men jiù tíng zài nǎ lǐ ; bù shì suǒ yǒu dì fāng dōu yòng tóng yī gè bàn fǎ zhòng zuò . zhè yàng liàn shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , wǒ zhì shǎo zhī dào xià yī cì yào zhù yì nǎ gè wèi zhì .
lines.en: My friend suggested reading the lines as ordinary speech first, then trying with the music. I practised the fast part separately instead of restarting every time. We stopped where the recording had missing characters rather than redoing every part the same way. After ten minutes I knew which spot to focus on next.

lines.zh: 回去时，活动还没结束。有个新朋友问我是不是下次也来。我没有马上说一定会唱得更好，只说想再试一次，也问他平时怎么练。他说自己第一次更紧张，拿着话筒还忘了音乐已经开始。听见这个，我终于笑了，不是因为他的失误好笑，而是觉得自己不那么孤单了。
lines.py: huí qù shí , huó dòng hái méi jié shù . yǒu gè xīn péng you wèn wǒ shì bú shì xià cì yě lái . wǒ méi yǒu mǎ shàng shuō yí dìng huì chàng de gèng hǎo , zhǐ shuō xiǎng zài shì yī cì , yě wèn tā píng shí zěn me liàn . tā shuō zì jǐ dì yī cì gèng jǐn zhāng , ná zhe huà tǒng hái wàng le yīn yuè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ . tīng jiàn zhè gè , wǒ zhōng yú xiào le , bù shì yīn wèi tā de shī wù hǎo xiào , ér shì jué de zì jǐ bù nà me gū dān le .
lines.en: The event was still going when we returned. A new friend asked whether I’d come next time. I said I’d like another try and asked how he practised. He said he’d been even more nervous his first time, forgetting the music had started while holding the microphone. I finally laughed—not at his mistake, but because I felt less alone.

lines.zh: 那天回家，我把第二句要练的位置在纸上圈出来，又存下新朋友的联系方式。他已经发来一条消息，说下次别忘了先唱再问听不听得见。我一边看一边笑，回他你也别忘了听音乐。我还是想把那两个字练好，不过想到下次进去已经有认识的人，心里没有刚出门时那么紧了。
lines.py: nà tiān huí jiā , wǒ bǎ dì èr jù yào liàn de wèi zhì zài zhǐ shàng quān chū lái , yòu cún xià xīn péng you de lián xì fāng shì . tā yǐ jīng fā lái yī tiáo xiāo xī , shuō xià cì bié wàng le xiān chàng zài wèn tīng bù tīng de jiàn . wǒ yī biān kàn yī biān xiào , huí tā nǐ yě bié wàng le tīng yīn yuè . wǒ hái shi xiǎng bǎ nà liǎng gè zì liàn hǎo , bù guò xiǎng dào xià cì jìn qù yǐ jīng yǒu rèn shi de rén , xīn lǐ méi yǒu gāng chū mén shí nà me jǐn le .
lines.en: At home I circled the spot in the second line that needed practice and saved my new friend's contact details. He'd already messaged: next time, sing before asking if anyone could hear me. Laughing, I told him not to forget to listen for the music either. I still wanted to get those two words right, but knowing I'd recognise someone next time made me less anxious.

The missed words are denied

It shows everyone deliberately mocked the performer

extraReadings.title: Can you hear me?
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你第一次真的忘了音乐已经开始？
lines.py: nǐ dì yī cì zhēn de wàng le yīn yuè yǐ jīng kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: Did you really forget the music had started your first time?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 真的。我还在问大家能不能听见我。
lines.py: zhēn de . wǒ hái zài wèn dà jiā néng bù néng tīng jiàn wǒ .
lines.en: Really. I was still asking if everyone could hear me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 大家怎么说？
lines.py: dà jiā zěn me shuō ?
lines.en: What did they say?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有人说听见了，还说音乐也听见了。
lines.py: yǒu rén shuō tīng jiàn le , hái shuō yīn yuè yě tīng jiàn le .
lines.en: Someone said yes—and that they could hear the music too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个提醒挺清楚的。
lines.py: zhè gè tí xǐng tǐng qīng chǔ de .
lines.en: That was a pretty clear reminder.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我当时没听懂，还问是不是太大声。
lines.py: wǒ dāng shí méi tīng dǒng , hái wèn shì bú shì tài dà shēng .
lines.en: I didn’t understand then and asked if it was too loud.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 所以后来呢？
lines.py: suǒ yǐ hòu lái ne ?
lines.en: So what happened then?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 后来有人把音乐停了，说重新来。我才明白。
lines.py: hòu lái yǒu rén bǎ yīn yuè tíng le , shuō chóng xīn lái . wǒ cái míng bái .
lines.en: Someone stopped the music and said we’d restart. Only then did I understand.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你还能笑着讲，看来已经不怕了。
lines.py: nǐ hái néng xiào zhe jiǎng , kàn lái yǐ jīng bù pà le .
lines.en: You can laugh about it now. Looks like you’re not afraid anymore.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谁说不怕？讲以前的很容易，等会儿轮到我还是怕。
lines.py: shéi shuō bù pà ? jiǎng yǐ qián de hěn róng yì , děng huì ér lún dào wǒ hái shi pà .
lines.en: Who says I’m not afraid? Talking about the past is easy; I’m still scared when my turn comes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我等会儿提醒你音乐开始了。
lines.py: nà wǒ děng huì ér tí xǐng nǐ yīn yuè kāi shǐ le .
lines.en: Then I’ll remind you when the music starts.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，这次我先唱，唱完再问听不听得见。
lines.py: hǎo , zhè cì wǒ xiān chàng , chàng wán zài wèn tīng bù tīng de jiàn .
lines.en: Okay. This time I’ll sing first and ask if they can hear me afterwards.
lines.speaker: b

choices: That the music has already started
That the microphone is a train ticket
That the event was cancelled
questions.answer: That the music has already started

choices: That the friend is no longer nervous about the next turn
That the friend has a memory of the earlier event
That someone once stopped the music to restart
questions.answer: That the friend is no longer nervous about the next turn

extraReadings.title: Comfort that makes room for the truth: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 紧张归紧张，你唱完了 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 谢谢你安慰我，不过我想先安静一会儿。
lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ ān wèi wǒ , bù guò wǒ xiǎng xiān ān jìng yī huì er .
lines.en: Thanks for comforting me, but I’d like a quiet moment first.

lines.zh: 她没有急着安慰，只问我想不想说。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu jí zhe ān wèi , zhǐ wèn wǒ xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō .
lines.en: She didn’t rush to reassure me; she just asked if I wanted to talk.

lines.zh: 你能耐心听完，再说哪里要改吗？
lines.py: nǐ néng nài xīn tīng wán , zài shuō nǎ lǐ yào gǎi ma ?
lines.en: Could you listen patiently to the end before saying what to change?

lines.zh: 他很有耐心，同一句教了我三次。
lines.py: tā hěn yǒu nài xīn , tóng yī jù jiào le wǒ sān cì .
lines.en: He was patient and taught me the same sentence three times.

lines.zh: 我想换个心态，把这次当作练习。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng huàn gè xīn tài , bǎ zhè cì dàng zuò liàn xí .
lines.en: I’d like to treat this as practice with a different mindset.

lines.zh: 比赛前，她的心态比以前平稳。
lines.py: bǐ sài qián , tā de xīn tài bǐ yǐ qián píng wěn .
lines.en: Her mindset was steadier than before the competition.

lines.zh: 看你忙了这么久，我有点心疼。
lines.py: kàn nǐ máng le zhè me jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn xīn téng .
lines.en: I feel for you after seeing how long you’ve been busy.

lines.zh: 她很心疼那只受伤的小猫。
lines.py: tā hěn xīn téng nà zhǐ shòu shāng de xiǎo māo .
lines.en: She felt sorry for the injured kitten.

lines.zh: 老师鼓励我再试一次。
lines.py: lǎo shī gǔ lì wǒ zài shì yī cì .
lines.en: The teacher encouraged me to try again.

lines.zh: 你的鼓励让我愿意把话说完。
lines.py: nǐ de gǔ lì ràng wǒ yuàn yì bǎ huà shuō wán .
lines.en: Your encouragement made me willing to finish what I was saying.

lines.zh: 这次结果对他的打击很大。
lines.py: zhè cì jié guǒ duì tā de dǎ jī hěn dà .
lines.en: This result was a major blow to him.

lines.zh: 我不是想打击你，只是提醒时间不够。
lines.py: wǒ bù shì xiǎng dǎ jī nǐ , zhǐ shì tí xǐng shí jiān bù gòu .
lines.en: I’m not trying to discourage you; I’m pointing out there isn’t enough time.

lines.zh: 我在第二句有一个失误。
lines.py: wǒ zài dì èr jù yǒu yī gè shī wù .
lines.en: I made a mistake in the second line.

lines.zh: 这次失误没有改变最后的结果。
lines.py: zhè cì shī wù méi yǒu gǎi biàn zuì hòu de jié guǒ .
lines.en: This error didn’t change the final outcome.

lines.zh: 没有达到自己的目标，我有点失望。
lines.py: méi yǒu dá dào zì jǐ de mù biāo , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
lines.en: I’m a little disappointed I didn’t reach my own goal.

lines.zh: 她失望地把没用上的票收起来。
lines.py: tā shī wàng de bǎ méi yòng shàng de piào shōu qǐ lái .
lines.en: She put away the unused ticket in disappointment.

lines.zh: 我为她坚持完成这件事感到自豪。
lines.py: wǒ wèi tā jiān chí wán chéng zhè jiàn shì gǎn dào zì háo .
lines.en: I’m proud of her for seeing it through.

lines.zh: 这座城市的居民为自己的传统自豪。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì de jū mín wèi zì jǐ de chuán tǒng zì háo .
lines.en: Residents of this city are proud of their traditions.

lines.zh: 第一次上台，我用了很大勇气。
lines.py: dì yī cì shàng tái , wǒ yòng le hěn dà yǒng qì .
lines.en: It took courage for me to go on stage the first time.

lines.zh: 我终于有勇气问那个问题了。
lines.py: wǒ zhōng yú yǒu yǒng qì wèn nà gè wèn tí le .
lines.en: I finally had the courage to ask that question.

lines.zh: 这段太快，我跟得很吃力。
lines.py: zhè duàn tài kuài , wǒ gēn de hěn chī lì .
lines.en: This part is so fast I struggle to keep up.

lines.zh: 他一个人搬这个箱子很吃力。
lines.py: tā yī gè rén bān zhè gè xiāng zi hěn chī lì .
lines.en: He struggles to carry this box alone.

lines.zh: 休息以后，我恢复了一点精神。
lines.py: xiū xī yǐ hòu , wǒ huī fù le yī diǎn jīng shén .
lines.en: After resting, I got some energy back.

lines.zh: 丢掉的文件能恢复吗？
lines.py: diū diào de wén jiàn néng huī fù ma ?
lines.en: Can the lost file be restored?

lines.zh: 我不是不想说，只是缺乏练习机会。
lines.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng shuō , zhǐ shì quē fá liàn xí jī huì .
lines.en: I do want to speak; I just lack chances to practise.

lines.zh: 这个计划缺乏具体的时间安排。
lines.py: zhè gè jì huà quē fá jù tǐ de shí jiān ān pái .
lines.en: This plan lacks a specific schedule.

lines.zh: 第一次听，难以判断他是什么意思。
lines.py: dì yī cì tīng , nán yǐ pàn duàn tā shì shén me yì si .
lines.en: On first hearing, it’s difficult to judge what he means.

lines.zh: 我难以接受只凭一句话就下结论。
lines.py: wǒ nán yǐ jiē shòu zhǐ píng yī jù huà jiù xià jié lùn .
lines.en: I find it hard to accept a conclusion based on one sentence.

lines.zh: 她渴望有一次自己选择的机会。
lines.py: tā kě wàng yǒu yī cì zì jǐ xuǎn zé de jī huì .
lines.en: She longs for a chance to choose for herself.

lines.zh: 我很渴望和大家自然地聊起来。
lines.py: wǒ hěn kě wàng hé dà jiā zì rán de liáo qǐ lái .
lines.en: I really want to start chatting naturally with everyone.

lines.zh: 他无奈地说，票已经卖完了。
lines.py: tā wú nài de shuō , piào yǐ jīng mài wán le .
lines.en: He said helplessly that the tickets had sold out.

lines.zh: 我有点无奈，只好等下一班。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn wú nài , zhǐ hǎo děng xià yī bān .
lines.en: I had no good option but to wait for the next service.

lines.zh: 我受不了大家同时说话，听不清。
lines.py: wǒ shòu bù liǎo dà jiā tóng shí shuō huà , tīng bù qīng .
lines.en: I can’t cope with everyone talking at once; I can’t hear clearly.

lines.zh: 她受不了屋里这么热，打开了窗。
lines.py: tā shòu bù liǎo wū lǐ zhè me rè , dǎ kāi le chuāng .
lines.en: She couldn’t bear the heat in the room and opened the window.

lines.zh: 我担心自己又会漏掉第二句。
lines.py: wǒ dān xīn zì jǐ yòu huì lòu diào dì èr jù .
lines.en: I’m worried I’ll miss the second line again.

lines.zh: 他担心朋友找不到地方，就发了地图。
lines.py: tā dān xīn péng you zhǎo bù dào dì fāng , jiù fā le dì tú .
lines.en: He worried his friend wouldn’t find the place and sent a map.

lines.zh: 我还在适应台上的声音。
lines.py: wǒ hái zài shì yìng tái shàng de shēng yīn .
lines.en: I’m still getting used to the sound on stage.

lines.zh: 她花了一周才适应新的时间表。
lines.py: tā huā le yī zhōu cái shì yìng xīn de shí jiān biǎo .
lines.en: It took her a week to adapt to the new schedule.

lines.zh: 练完以后，我依然有点紧张。
lines.py: liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ yī rán yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: After practising I was still a little nervous.

lines.zh: 天气变了，他的计划依然没有变。
lines.py: tiān qì biàn le , tā de jì huà yī rán méi yǒu biàn .
lines.en: The weather changed but his plan stayed the same.

lines.zh: 这只是我的主观感受，你可以不一样。
lines.py: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu , nǐ kě yǐ bù yī yàng .
lines.en: This is only my subjective impression; yours may differ.

lines.zh: 只凭第一印象判断，容易太主观。
lines.py: zhǐ píng dì yī yìn xiàng pàn duàn , róng yì tài zhǔ guān .
lines.en: Judging only by a first impression can be too subjective.

lines.zh: 这次效果比我的预期好。
lines.py: zhè cì xiào guǒ bǐ wǒ de yù qī hǎo .
lines.en: The result was better than I expected.

lines.zh: 预期太高，有时更容易失望。
lines.py: yù qī tài gāo , yǒu shí gèng róng yì shī wàng .
lines.en: Sometimes high expectations make disappointment more likely.

lines.zh: 当时是什么情形，你再说详细一点。
lines.py: dāng shí shì shén me qíng xíng , nǐ zài shuō xiáng xì yī diǎn .
lines.en: Tell me more about what was happening at the time.

lines.zh: 换一种情形，同一句话可能不同。
lines.py: huàn yī zhǒng qíng xíng , tóng yī jù huà kě néng bù tóng .
lines.en: In a different situation the same sentence may mean something else.

lines.zh: 演出结束以后，大家一起鼓掌。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu , dà jiā yì qǐ gǔ zhǎng .
lines.en: Everyone applauded after the performance.

lines.zh: 他还没说完，后面已经有人鼓掌了。
lines.py: tā hái méi shuō wán , hòu miàn yǐ jīng yǒu rén gǔ zhǎng le .
lines.en: Someone at the back started clapping before he’d finished speaking.

lines.zh: 这次活动由我负责安排顺序，一共有十二个人准备上台。有些人认识很久，有些第一次来。开始以前，我问大家想完整唱一段，还是只试自己选的几句。两个人选了短的部分，其他人选了整段，我们照着他们的选择安排，没有要求每个人一样长。
lines.py: zhè cì huó dòng yóu wǒ fù zé ān pái shùn xù , yī gòng yǒu shí èr gè rén zhǔn bèi shàng tái . yǒu xiē rén rèn shi hěn jiǔ , yǒu xiē dì yī cì lái . kāi shǐ yǐ qián , wǒ wèn dà jiā xiǎng wán zhěng chàng yī duàn , hái shi zhǐ shì zì jǐ xuǎn de jǐ jù . liǎng gè rén xuǎn le duǎn de bù fèn , qí tā rén xuǎn le zhěng duàn , wǒ men zhào zhe tā men de xuǎn zé ān pái , méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén yī yàng zhǎng .
lines.en: I arranged the order for twelve people at this event. Some were familiar faces and others were new. Before starting, I asked whether they wanted a full section or a few selected lines. Two chose short parts, and the others chose full sections. We used their choices rather than requiring identical lengths.

lines.zh: 一个第一次上台的朋友唱到第二句时停了一下，前排的人指了开始的位置。他后来接上了，但走下来时看着地面，没有和旁边的人说话。我过去问他要不要喝水。他说先出去一会儿，另一个熟悉他的朋友陪他走了。我就告诉大家，下一位准备，不把所有人的注意都留在他身上。
lines.py: yī gè dì yī cì shàng tái de péng you chàng dào dì èr jù shí tíng le yī xià , qián pái de rén zhǐ le kāi shǐ de wèi zhì . tā hòu lái jiē shàng le , dàn zǒu xià lái shí kàn zhe dì miàn , méi yǒu hé páng biān de rén shuō huà . wǒ guò qù wèn tā yào bù yào hē shuǐ . tā shuō xiān chū qù yī huì er , lìng yī gè shú xī tā de péng you péi tā zǒu le . wǒ jiù gào sù dà jiā , xià yī wèi zhǔn bèi , bù bǎ suǒ yǒu rén de zhù yì dōu liú zài tā shēn shàng .
lines.en: A first-time performer paused in the second line, then restarted after someone in front pointed to the entry. He looked down afterwards and didn’t talk. I asked if he’d like water. He wanted a moment outside, and a friend went with him. I moved to the next performer rather than keeping everyone’s attention on him.

lines.zh: 后来有人问，刚才鼓掌是不是让他别再唱。我说不是，我是在他唱完以后鼓掌，谢谢他参加。那个人说自己坐在后面，只听见一阵掌声，没看见他已经放下话筒。我指了指旁边的空椅子，让他下次坐近一点。他笑着说好，上次也是没看清，回来以后自己想了半天。
lines.py: hòu lái yǒu rén wèn , gāng cái gǔ zhǎng shì bú shì ràng tā bié zài chàng . wǒ shuō bù shì , wǒ shì zài tā chàng wán yǐ hòu gǔ zhǎng , xiè xiè tā cān jiā . nà gè rén shuō zì jǐ zuò zài hòu miàn , zhǐ tīng jiàn yī zhèn zhǎng shēng , méi kàn jiàn tā yǐ jīng fàng xià huà tǒng . wǒ zhǐ le zhǐ páng biān de kōng yǐ zi , ràng tā xià cì zuò jìn yī diǎn . tā xiào zhe shuō hǎo , shàng cì yě shì méi kàn qīng , huí lái yǐ hòu zì jǐ xiǎng le bàn tiān .
lines.en: Someone later asked whether the applause meant he should stop singing. No, I said: I clapped after he finished, to thank him. Sitting at the back, the questioner had heard applause but hadn't seen the microphone lowered. I pointed to an empty chair nearby and suggested sitting closer next time. He laughed: last time he'd missed something too and spent ages wondering about it afterwards.

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候，几个朋友开始讲自己的第一次。有个人说，他本来想表现得很自然，一拿起话筒却把介绍自己的句子忘了。另一个说，她练得最多的地方没有错，平时觉得最容易的一句反而漏了。大家没有照着一种经历来安慰，而是把自己的具体情况说出来，话题就从一个人的失误变成了共同经历。
lines.py: chī dōng xi de shí hou , jǐ gè péng you kāi shǐ jiǎng zì jǐ de dì yī cì . yǒu gè rén shuō , tā běn lái xiǎng biǎo xiàn de hěn zì rán , yī ná qǐ huà tǒng què bǎ jiè shào zì jǐ de jù zi wàng le . lìng yī gè shuō , tā liàn de zuì duō de dì fāng méi yǒu cuò , píng shí jué de zuì róng yì de yī jù fǎn ér lòu le . dà jiā méi yǒu zhào zhe yī zhǒng jīng lì lái ān wèi , ér shì bǎ zì jǐ de jù tǐ qíng kuàng shuō chū lái , huà tí jiù cóng yī gè rén de shī wù biàn chéng le gòng tóng jīng lì .
lines.en: Over food, people shared their first attempts. One had wanted to seem natural but forgot his introduction on picking up the microphone. Another made no error in the most-practised section but missed an apparently easy line. Their specific accounts shifted the conversation from one person’s mistake to shared experiences.

lines.zh: 我想起自己以前带活动，常说“别紧张，一定没问题”。有时这句话能让气氛轻松一点，有时对方还是会紧张，甚至不知道出了问题该怎么办。这次我试着多说一点实际安排：可以选短的部分；忘了可以重新找开始的位置；结束以后，可以自己决定什么时候听录音。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǐ qián dài huó dòng , cháng shuō bié jǐn zhāng , yí dìng méi wèn tí . yǒu shí zhè jù huà néng ràng qì fēn qīng sōng yī diǎn , yǒu shí duì fāng hái shi huì jǐn zhāng , shèn zhì bù zhī dào chū le wèn tí gāi zěn me bàn . zhè cì wǒ shì zhe duō shuō yī diǎn shí jì ān pái : kě yǐ xuǎn duǎn de bù fèn ; wàng le kě yǐ chóng xīn zhǎo kāi shǐ de wèi zhì ; jié shù yǐ hòu , kě yǐ zì jǐ jué dìng shén me shí hou tīng lù yīn .
lines.en: I remembered telling people, “Don’t be nervous; it’ll definitely be fine.” Sometimes that relaxed the atmosphere; sometimes they remained nervous and didn’t know what to do if something went wrong. This time I gave practical options: a shorter part, finding an entry again if they forgot, and choosing when to listen to the recording afterwards.

lines.zh: 活动结束前，那位出去休息的朋友回来了，手里拿着刚买的面包。他问下次还能不能带同一段，又说已经找到了要练的位置。我把日期发给他，请他想好唱哪几句以后告诉我。旁边的人凑过来看，说这首他也在练，两个人很快交换了联系方式，约好先把第二句一起读清楚。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù qián , nà wèi chū qù xiū xī de péng you huí lái le , shǒu lǐ ná zhe gāng mǎi de miàn bāo . tā wèn xià cì hái néng bù néng dài tóng yī duàn , yòu shuō yǐ jīng zhǎo dào le yào liàn de wèi zhì . wǒ bǎ rì qī fā gěi tā , qǐng tā xiǎng hǎo chàng nǎ jǐ jù yǐ hòu gào sù wǒ . páng biān de rén còu guò lái kàn , shuō zhè shǒu tā yě zài liàn , liǎng gè rén hěn kuài jiāo huàn le lián xì fāng shì , yuē hǎo xiān bǎ dì èr jù yì qǐ dú qīng chǔ .
lines.en: Before the event ended, the friend who'd stepped outside returned with a newly bought bread roll. He wanted to bring the same section next time and knew what needed practice. I sent the date and asked him to tell me which lines he chose. Someone beside him leaned over: he was practising that song too. They exchanged details and agreed to read the second line together first.

lines.zh: 收好东西以后，我在群里发了今天的照片。有一张拍到两个人低头看同一页歌词，另一张里，第一次拿话筒的朋友正在笑。第二天，群里有人问下一次的时间，也有人发来自己在家练的短录音。我把报名的位置留在消息最后，写了完整唱和只试几句两种选择，没想到最先回复的还是昨天出去休息的那位。
lines.py: shōu hǎo dōng xi yǐ hòu , wǒ zài qún lǐ fā le jīn tiān de zhào piān . yǒu yī zhāng pāi dào liǎng gè rén dī tóu kàn tóng yī yè gē cí , lìng yī zhāng lǐ , dì yī cì ná huà tǒng de péng you zhèng zài xiào . dì èr tiān , qún lǐ yǒu rén wèn xià yī cì de shí jiān , yě yǒu rén fā lái zì jǐ zài jiā liàn de duǎn lù yīn . wǒ bǎ bào míng de wèi zhì liú zài xiāo xī zuì hòu , xiě le wán zhěng chàng hé zhǐ shì jǐ jù liǎng zhǒng xuǎn zé , méi xiǎng dào zuì xiān huí fù de hái shi zuó tiān chū qù xiū xī de nà wèi .
lines.en: After packing up I posted the photos to our group. One showed two people studying the same lyric sheet; another caught the first-time microphone holder laughing. The next day people asked about the next date and shared short practice recordings. At the end of the message I offered full sections or just a few lines. To my surprise, yesterday's friend who'd gone out for a rest replied first.

prompt.zh: 第二句漏了两字，后面接上了。你不用说全部都完美。

prompt.en: Two words were missed, then you picked it up. You do not need to call it all perfect.

choices: 我没这样说，只是听见你后来接上了。
对，你刚才说从头到尾都没漏字。
你说后面一直没接上，我也听到了。
tasks.answer: 我没这样说，只是听见你后来接上了。
tasks.why: The reply distinguishes observation from blanket praise.

prompt.zh: 你说先吃东西再听。现在还没吃，想现在听吗？
prompt.py: nǐ shuō xiān chī dōng xi zài tīng . xiàn zài hái méi chī , xiǎng xiàn zài tīng ma ?
prompt.en: You said to eat before listening. We have not eaten yet; would you like to listen now?

choices: 吃完再听吧，先让我休息一下。
吃完了，我刚才已经把饭吃完。
我没说过先吃，刚才只说立即听。
tasks.answer: 吃完再听吧，先让我休息一下。
tasks.why: The response chooses the later listening sequence.

prompt.zh: 我还在问大家听不听得见，音乐已经响了。开始了吗？
prompt.py: wǒ hái zài wèn dà jiā tīng bù tīng de jiàn , yīn yuè yǐ jīng xiǎng le . kāi shǐ le ma ?
prompt.en: I am still asking whether people can hear me, but music is already playing. Has it started?

choices: 已经开始了，我们停一下重新来。
还没响，我们还没放音乐。
已经结束了，不用重新开始。
tasks.answer: 已经开始了，我们停一下重新来。
tasks.why: The reply directly addresses the missed musical start.

line.zh: 紧张【归】紧张，你还是唱完了。
line.py: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi chàng wán le .
line.en: Nervous or not, you still finished.

line.zh: 音乐快【得】我都跟不上了。
line.py: yīn yuè kuài de wǒ dōu gēn bù shàng le .
line.en: The music is so fast I cannot keep up.

line.py: lǎo shī gǔ lì wǒ zài shì yī cì .
line.en: The teacher encouraged me to try again.

right.en: Thanks for comforting me, but I’d like a quiet moment first.

right.py: zhè cì jié guǒ duì tā de dǎ jī hěn dà .
right.en: This result was a major blow to him.

pairs.left: This part is so fast I struggle to keep up.

right.zh: 这段太快，我跟得很吃力。
right.py: zhè duàn tài kuài , wǒ gēn de hěn chī lì .
right.en: This part is so fast I struggle to keep up.

tasks.title: Match the situation to the line

pairs.left: Can the lost file be restored?

right.py: diū diào de wén jiàn néng huī fù ma ?
right.en: Can the lost file be restored?

pairs.left: He worried his friend wouldn’t find the place and sent a map.

right.zh: 他担心朋友找不到地方，就发了地图。
right.py: tā dān xīn péng you zhǎo bù dào dì fāng , jiù fā le dì tú .
right.en: He worried his friend wouldn’t find the place and sent a map.

pairs.left: Judging only by a first impression can be too subjective.

right.zh: 只凭第一印象判断，容易太主观。
right.py: zhǐ píng dì yī yìn xiàng pàn duàn , róng yì tài zhǔ guān .
right.en: Judging only by a first impression can be too subjective.

right.zh: 我不是不想说，只是缺乏练习机会。
right.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng shuō , zhǐ shì quē fá liàn xí jī huì .
right.en: I do want to speak; I just lack chances to practise.

pairs.left: She longs for a chance to choose for herself.

right.zh: 她渴望有一次自己选择的机会。
right.py: tā kě wàng yǒu yī cì zì jǐ xuǎn zé de jī huì .
right.en: She longs for a chance to choose for herself.

pairs.left: Tell me more about what was happening at the time.

right.py: dāng shí shì shén me qíng xíng , nǐ zài shuō xiáng xì yī diǎn .
right.en: Tell me more about what was happening at the time.
